title: Live Nov 6: asked agreement to a step the tester never saw
origin: Yanni live on staging, Nov 2 (simulated days), issue #131

answers.what: customer discovery for a side project: how freelancers handle client follow-ups

history.text: Hey! It's 6:40, so the Alex draft is up. Two lines is plenty. Send me a screenshot when it's written, and don't send it to him yet.

plan.step: Write 2 interview questions about the past: an opener plus one follow-up
plan.destination: find a problem worth building for by talking to freelancers
plan.proof_note: a photo or screenshot of what you made, or a voice note
plan.reason: Talking to real freelancers about follow-ups shows whether the problem is real.

step_days.step: Write down 3 freelancers you could ask for a quick chat, photo of the list
step_days.proof_seen: photo: Alex, Priya, Sam with a follow-up situation each
step_days.reflection: Five minutes was enough, felt easy; reaching out feels a little intimidating. Wants to keep tomorrow at 5 minutes.

step_days.step: Say all three questions out loud twice, voice note of the best run
step_days.proof_seen: voice note of the three questions
step_days.reflection: Saying the three questions out loud felt okay.

step_days.step: Write 2 interview questions about the past (2-minute version)
step_days.reflection: 2-minute version felt manageable even when tired. Learned that asking what they actually did gets something concrete. Wants to also ask what they used to track follow-ups. Ready for 5 minutes, wants to practice before contacting anyone.

today_step.step: At home at 6:30 pm, 5 minutes: draft a short text to Alex asking for a 10-minute chat about how he handles client follow-ups. Don't send it yet. Send a photo or screenshot of the draft.

testerLines: [photo alex-draft.jpg: an unsent Notes draft to Alex asking for 10 minutes, no pitch]
Asking for his time. I worry it’ll feel like I’m bothering him
whatWentWrong: Sorry, I got ahead of myself there. I'm still waiting on your answer: does tomorrow's step work for you?
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH goes deeper on the worry about bothering Alex before any next step, and never asks agreement to a step the tester hasn't seen.
